name: Octree Light Propagation Volumes
definition: A method for representing Light Propagation Volumes using a full octree data structure to allow light from regular point light sources to be injected, enabling faster propagation and rendering by performing propagation at lower resolutions for distant areas.
summary: Octree Light Propagation Volumes is a real-time global illumination technique using a hierarchical octree to prioritize proximity to geometry over viewer distance, enabling faster rendering by varying resolution across world space.
